definitions.explanation: Official relations between countries at the government level. Commonly appears in news about international politics.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{国交|こっこう}を{断絶|だんぜつ}した。
examples.english: The two countries severed diplomatic relations.

examples.japanese: {国交|こっこう}{正常化|せいじょうか}から{五十|ごじゅう}{年|ねん}を{迎|むか}え、{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A commemorative ceremony was held to mark fifty years since the normalization of diplomatic relations.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term primarily used in news and political contexts. Key set phrases include {国交|こっこう}を{結|むす}ぶ (to establish relations), {国交|こっこう}を{断絶|だんぜつ}する (to sever relations), and {国交|こっこう}{正常化|せいじょうか} (normalization of relations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国交|こっこう}を{結|むす}ぶ: to establish diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}を{断絶|だんぜつ}する: to sever diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}{回復|かいふく}: restoration of diplomatic relations
- {国交|こっこう}がない: to have no diplomatic relations
